identity.description: An attacker uses smbclient to perform an NTLM relay attack against a target host, triggering the 'Rare NTLM Access By User To Host' alert. The attack involves authenticating with a target using NTLM credentials and accessing remote shares.

expected_artifacts.description: Outbound SMB connection to target IP

biocs.name: Rare NTLM Access By User To Host
biocs.description: Detects when a user performs an NTLM authentication to a remote host that is not typically accessed by that user.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'smbclient'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe'
